card_en: Add krat, times, to a number to say how often: enkrat, once; dvakrat, twice; trikrat, three times. Kolikokrat asks how many times, and na dan means a day.

example.en: One tablet three times a day.

quick_check.explain_en: Kolikokrat is koliko, how many, plus krat, times.

helper_de: Like German -mal: einmal, dreimal, wie oft.
helper_en: English writes three times in two words; Slovenian joins them: trikrat.
